_comment: Opt-in telemetry sent directly to Dash0 (no Collector)
_description: Sends OTLP/HTTP straight to Dash0's ingress. The auth token must NOT be committed here. Supply the Authorization header via .gw/config.local.json (gitignored, see config.local.telemetry.json) or the OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS env var.
_usage: Set endpoint to your Dash0 region ingress. This committed file holds only non-secret settings; the token comes from config.local.json or env.
